articles.summary: BEIJING , Nov. 6, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Autohome Inc. (NYSE: ATHM; HKEX: 2518) (" Autohome " or the "Company"), the leading online destination for automobile consumers in China , today announced its unaudited financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2025 .
articles.title: Autohome Inc. Announces Unaudited Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
